title: Program Admission and Service Specialist
description:
Position Summary

The Program Admission and Service Specialist is responsible for coordinating all aspects of participant admissions and ongoing service management for facility-based programs, including Day Habilitation, Afterschool, and Saturday services. This role ensures a smooth intake process, timely authorizations and reauthorizations, completion of required meetings, and accurate communication of program updates to families, teams, and stakeholders. The Program Admission and Service Specialist serves as a primary point of contact for prospective and enrolled participants and supports continuity of services through proactive coordination, scheduling, and documentation.



Key Responsibilities



Admissions & Enrollment

• Manage and coordinate the full admissions process from referral to program start

• Respond to inquiries from families, case managers, schools, and referral sources

• Conduct intake screenings and collect required documentation

• Verify eligibility criteria in accordance with program and funding requirements

• Schedule and facilitate intake meetings and tours as needed

• Maintain waitlists and track enrollment capacity across programs

• Prepare admission packets and ensure all required forms are completed



Authorizations & Reauthorizations

• Submit initial service authorization requests to funding sources

• Track authorization periods and ensure timely reauthorization submissions

• Monitor service units and utilization

• Communicate with payers, support coordinators, and treatment teams regarding approvals or discrepancies

• Maintain accurate documentation to support billing and compliance requirements



Participant Support & Service Coordination

• Serve as a point of contact for participants and caregivers regarding services

• Coordinate quarterly, semi-annual, and annual meetings as required

• Assist with service plan updates and distribution to appropriate stakeholders

• Support transition between programs or service levels as needed

• Facilitate communication between families, program staff, clinicians, and providers



Program Updates & Documentation

• Maintain participant records in accordance with regulatory standards

• Enter and update data in electronic health records or case management systems

• Prepare reports related to admissions, authorizations, census, and utilization

• Support compliance activities and audits as needed

• Communicate program updates, schedule changes, and announcements to families and tea
mbers



Qualifications

• Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Human Services, Social Work, Psychology, Education, or related field preferred

• Experience with developmental disabilities, behavioral health, or day program services strongly preferred

• Prior experience in admissions, intake, case management, service coordination, or authorizations required

• Familiarity with Medicaid, MCOs, and waiver programs preferred

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

• Excellent communication and customer-service skills

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office and electronic records systems



Core Competencies

• Customer service and family-centered approach

• Cultural competence and sensitivity

• Professional written and verbal communication

• Ability to maintain confidentiality and HIPAA compliance

• Problem-solving and follow-through

• Team collaboration and independent work capability



Working Conditions

• Remote 9am-6pm, Mon- Fri, US New York Time

• May require occasional evening or weekend hours for meetings or events

title: HVAC Administration & Scheduling Virtual Assistant (HVAC + AroFlo Experience Strongly Preferred)
description:
HVAC Administration & Scheduling Virtual Assistant (HVAC + AroFlo Experience Strongly Preferred)



Full-Time | Remote | Philippines-Based



About Our Company

We are a growing, professional air conditioning and refrigeration company based in Melbourne, Australia, specialising in premium residential HVAC solutions including servicing, repairs, installations, preventative maintenance and energy-efficient upgrades.

We pride ourselves on delivering exceptional customer service, high-quality workmanship, and a smooth customer experience from first enquiry through to job completion.

We are looking for an experienced, highly organised and proactive Virtual Assistant with HVAC/trade administration experience, ideally with AroFlo knowledge, to become a key part of our team.



This is not a generic VA role - we are seeking someone who understands the fast-paced nature of a trade business and can confidently manage scheduling, customer communication, job administration, Director and technician support.



This is a highly collaborative role where you will work closely with the Director and Lead Technician on a daily basis, helping coordinate operations, scheduling, suppliers, customer communication and administration.



As a small but growing business, communication, accountability and initiative are essential. You will play a key role in helping keep jobs organised, technicians supported, and customers informed.



You must be comfortable receiving direction and feedback, while also being proactive and solutions-focused. We value people who can think ahead, solve problems independently, and take ownership - not simply wait to be told what to do.



While this is primarily an operational role supporting the Director and technicians, you will also assist with administrative, systems, customer experience or marketing-related tasks as briefed during key business projects or initiatives.



Schedule

Working Days + Times

Monday to Friday 

8am – 4:30p
lbourne, Australia time (AEST/AEDT) 

Full-time preferred

Occasional flexibility may be required during busy periods

Schedule technicians efficiently across multiple daily jobs using AroFlo

Reschedule jobs and manage urgent bookings 

Optimise technician runs to minimise travel time 

Liaise with technicians regarding job updates, ETA’s and scheduling changes 

Coordinate service, maintenance and installation bookings 

Monitor daily workflow and job progress – update schedule and Tasks at end of day



- AroFlo Job Management

Create and manage Tasks/jobs in AroFlo 

Update jobs, customer details and job/task notes 

Monitor job progress and workflow stages end-to-end

Ensure technicians complete required forms, checklists and compliance documentation 

Upload photos, documentation and customer records to AroFlo job

- Customer Service, Lead Management & Administration

Answer inbound customer enquiries (phone,
 and SMS) 

Follow up quotes, new and existing enquiries and booking requests 

Send booking confirmations and reminders 

Keep customers informed regarding technician arrival times and scheduling changes 

Manage the new lead process and customer journey end-to-end

Deliver a professional, friendly and organised customer experience 



- Invoicing & Administrative Support

Assist with quote preparation, sending and invoicing 

Track deposits and payment follow-up 

Maintain accurate CRM and customer records 

Support general administration and reporting tasks 

Assist with process improvements and workflow efficiencies 



- Daily Team Coordination

Work closely with the Director and Lead Technician to support daily operational requirements 

Take direction and implement instructions accurately and efficiently 

Maintain clear and regular communication with the team throughout the day 

Proactively identify scheduling, communication or operational issues before they become problems 

Use initiative to recommend solutions and keep workflows moving 



- Customer Communication & Business Support

Assist with customer communications including
, SMS and booking correspondence 

Support occasional administrative, systems and marketing-related tasks as briefed, including preparing social media posts, brochures, flyers and customer-facing materials using Canva (or similar platforms)

Previous HVAC, air conditioning, refrigeration or trade industry experience 

Experience using AroFlo or similar job management software is strongly preferred (priority will be given to applicants with AroFlo experience).

Minimum 2+ years administration, scheduling or customer service experience in a trade/service-based business 

Excellent spoken and written English (clear, confident and professional communication) 

Strong scheduling and organisational skills 

High attention to detail 

Strong problem-solving ability 

Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment 

Comfortable communicating with technicians, customers and business owners 

Strong sense of accountability and ownership 

Experience using Canva (or similar design platforms) to create basic marketing and creative assets as required (e.g. social media posts, brochures, flyers, customer communications and promotional materials)

Ability to follow brand guidelines, templates and instructions accurately

Comfortable preparing draft creative assets, understanding that all customer-facing communications and marketing materials will require approval prior to publishing or distribution



Technical Requirements

Quiet, professional home workspace 

Good quality headset and microphone

(Highly Desirable)

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to become a trusted, long-term part of a growing, family-run Australian trade business where your work will genuinely make a difference.



We are looking for someone who takes pride in quality work, values strong communication, and wants to grow with a supportive team long-term.



If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you. Please include a word " STAR " on the subject line to ensure you've carefully read the whole process.

title: Business Systems Administrator (Zoho One & Microsoft 365)
description:
About the Role 



We are seeking a highly capable and experienced Business Systems Administrator to take ownership of our Zoho One and Microsoft 365 environments while helping systemise, automate, secure, and scale operational workflows across the business. 



This role is a critical operational position responsible for ensuring our business systems remain secure, structured, efficient, automated, and fully visible across departments. The successful candidate will act as the internal owner of both the Zoho One ecosystem and the Microsoft 365 cloud environment, ensuring both platforms operate together as a unified operational backbone for the business. 



You will work closely with leadership to implement operational systems, workflows, automations, reporting structures, and governance standards based on clearly defined business requirements and operational goals. 



This is not a traditional IT support role, DevOps role, or helpdesk role. Instead, this is an operational systems ownership role focused on: 

- business systems administration  

- operational visibility  

- automation  

- workflow standardisation  

- Microsoft 365 administration  

- Zoho One ownership  

- security and governance  

- process optimisation  



The ideal candidate will be a genuine Zoho One expert with strong Microsoft 365 administration experience and practical automation skills using modern no-code/low-code platforms. 

---



Key Responsibilities



Zoho One Ownership & Administration:



Take full ownership of the Zoho One ecosystem across the business.  



Configure, manage, optimise, and maintain all relevant Zoho applications.  



Ensure Zoho operates as the central operational source of truth.  



Build scalable operational workflows and process structures within:  

- Zoho CRM  

- Zoho Projects  

- Zoho Flow  

- Zoho Analytics  

- Zoho Desk  

- Zoho People  

- Zoho Recruit  

- Zoho Sign  

- Zoho Vault  

-Zoho CPQ  



Structure and maintain pipelines, automations, dashboards, permissions, and operational workflows.  



Ensure operational consistency across departments through structured process implementation.  



Support leadership with ongoing process optimisation and system improvements.  

---



Microsoft 365 Ownership & Administration:



Take full ownership of the Microsoft 365 cloud environment across the business. 



Manage and maintain:  

- Microsoft 365 Admin Centre  

- SharePoint  

- Microsoft Teams  

- Entra ID / Azure Active Directory 

 

Manage all user provisioning, onboarding, offboarding, permissions, and access controls.  



Maintain security best practices across the Microsoft 365 environment.  



Configure and manage:  

- MFA policies  

- Conditional Access policies  

- Security groups  

User permissions  

- External sharing settings  

- Access governance  



Ensure proper structure and governance across SharePoint and Teams environments.  



Maintain operational security standards and monitor for potential security risks. 



Manage licensing, user roles, mailbox permissions, and collaboration settings.  



Support internal staff with Microsoft 365 operational issues and access requirements.  



Ensure the Microsoft 365 environment remains secure, organised, scalable, and professionally managed.  



Experience with Microsoft Power Automate would be desirable 

---



Workflow Automation & Operational Systems:



Build and maintain scalable operational automations across the business.  



Create automation systems that:  

- generate tasks  

- assign responsibilities  

- trigger notifications  

- escalate overdue actions  

- automate communications  

- improve operational visibility  



Reduce manual administration and remove reliance on memory-based processes.  



Translate operational requirements into scalable workflow systems.  



Maintain and optimise operational automations across departments.  

---



System Integrations & Automation Platforms:



Build and maintain integrations between:  

- Zoho One  

- Microsoft 365  

- SharePoint  

- Teams  

- Business communication platforms  



Configure and maintain workflow automation platforms such as:  

- n8n  

- Zoho Flow  

- Zapier  



Maintain integration reliability and troubleshoot workflow issues.  



Work with APIs, webhooks, triggers, and operational automation logic where required.  



Ensure data consistency and operational visibility across systems.

---



AI-Assisted Operational Optimisation:



Assist with implementing AI-assisted operational workflows using tools such as ChatGPT and Claude.  



Support leadership in improving operational efficiency using AI-assisted systems.  



Build AI-supported productivity workflows where appropriate.  



Assist with AI-enhanced communication, workflow routing, operational assistance, and process optimisation.  



Continuously identify opportunities where AI can improve internal operational efficiency.  

---



General:



Ready to learn and pick up new tools as the business needs them. 



Keep an eye on major updates for the tools we rely on. Sometimes, policy changes from these platforms can directly impact our clients and business. 



Comfortable building custom setups based on what the business actually needs, rather than just sticking to the standard out-of-the-box way. 



Share fresh insights and recommendations. Tell us what we're missing and what could actually help the business with its operations and processes. 



Good at documenting how our systems are set up and why we did it that way. We need someone to create and maintain technical SOPs so the whole team knows how to use our tools. 



Act as a technical bridge. When a process breaks down between two departments or a sudden need arises, you step in to fill the gap. 

---



Reporting, Governance & Operational Visibility:



Build dashboards, KPI visibility systems, and operational reporting structures.  



Ensure leadership has clear visibility into operational performance.  



Maintain structured governance across systems and operational workflows.  



Assist with operational auditing, workflow monitoring, and accountability reporting.  



Ensure systems remain scalable, organised, and operationally effective.  

---



Expected Experience & Qualifications:



Experience: 4+ years of proven experience in business systems administration, Zoho administration, Microsoft 365 administration, workflow automation, or operational systems roles.  



Zoho Expertise: Strong hands-on expertise with Zoho One applications, particularly Zoho CRM, Zoho Projects, Zoho Flow, Zoho Analytics, and Zoho Desk.

- permissions  

- user access  

- security policies  

- operational governance

Automation Platforms: Experience building automations using platforms such as n8n, Zoho Flow, Zapier, or similar tools.  



Integrations: Experience integrating multiple operational systems and platforms together.  



APIs & Webhooks: Comfortable working with APIs, webhooks, triggers, and automation logic.  



Operational Thinking: Strong operational and process-oriented mindset with the ability to structure scalable systems and workflows.  



Troubleshooting Skills: Strong diagnostic and problem-solving ability across operational systems and automations.  



Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work closely with leadership and operational teams.  



Organisation & Attention to Detail: Highly organised with strong attention to detail and structured thinking.

Microsoft certifications (MS-900, related Microsoft 365 certifications)  



Zoho certifications  



Experience with AI-assisted productivity and automation systems  



Experience with n8n self-hosted environments  



Familiarity with operational KPI reporting and dashboards  



Experience working within agencies or operationally complex businesses  



Understanding of process mapping and operational documentation  



Basic understanding of SQL, databases, or API authentication methods  



Experience implementing scalable operational governance structures

---  



Working Expectations:



Full-time role (40 hours per week)  



UK business hour overlap required  



Long-term operational ownership role  



Work closely with leadership to implement operational systems and improvements  



Maintain strong responsiveness, accountability, and operational ownership across systems and workflows

title: Supabase Backend Developer Tradelance v2
description:
ABOUT TRADELANCE

Tradelance is an Australian trades marketplace connecting clients with skilled tradespeople across the country. We are currently live on the App Store and are now preparing to build v2, a fully coded platform to replace our current no-code foundation. This is a ground up rebuild and you will be a core part of making it happen. We are building something meaningful and we need someone who takes genuine pride in writing clean, scalable, production ready backend architecture.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a skilled Supabase Backend Developer to design and build the entire backend infrastructure for Tradelance v2 from scratch. This is not a maintenance role. You will not be patching an existing system or managing legacy code. You will be building a robust, scalable backend that powers a two-sided marketplace from authentication and payments through to real time messaging and API integrations.



Your work will directly shape the future of the Tradelance platform. You will work closely with our lead developer and technical team under the direction of our Head of Development ensuring every architectural decision aligns with what we are building on the app and web side.



We are launching v1 on Wednesday June 3, 2026 and this role begins post-launch as we immediately transition into building v2. If you are available to start as soon as possible, we want to hear from you.



WHAT YOU WILL BE BUILDING

• Full backend architecture for a two-sided marketplace serving both clients and tradespeople

• Job posting, proposal, and hiring workflow backend

• User authentication and role-based access control client, tradie, and admin roles

• Payment and subscription handling via Stripe

• Real time notifications and messaging backend

• File and media storage for job images and user profiles

• API integrations with Google Maps, push notifications, and other third-party services



REQUIRED SKILLS

• Supabase database design, authentication, storage, and edge functions

• PostgreSQL, schema design, relationships, indexing, and query optimization

• REST and real-time API design and development

• Multi-user role and permission management

• Third-party API integration such as Stripe, Google, and similar services

• JavaScript or TypeScript

• Webhook setup and server-side automation

• Scalable data modeling and backend architecture from scratch

• Secure file and image storage handling

• Version control, Git and GitHub



NICE TO HAVE

• Node.js experience

• React Native or Flutter familiarity

• Mobile app backend experience

• No-code to coded migration experience

• Australian client or project experience

• CI/CD pipeline setup and management

• OpenAI or AI integration experience



WHAT WE OFFER

• Flexible full-time or part-time engagement based on your availability

• Direct collaboration with the founding team and lead developer

• Long-term growth opportunity as the platform scales from v1 to v2

• Meaningful work building the backbone of a growing Australian marketplace from the ground up

• Performance based rate review as your contribution and involvement grows

• Open to both Full-Time and Part-Time arrangements



HOW TO APPLY

Please send your application including the following:

• A brief introduction about yourself and your backend development background

• Your experience with Supabase and PostgreSQL specific projects or systems you have built

• Examples of previous work such as GitHub profile, portfolio, or project links

• Your availability: full-time or part-time and how many hours per week

• Your available start date



NOTE:

Applications without relevant Supabase and PostgreSQL experience will not be interviewed.

Overview:

We are an AI-powered lifestyle management platform built for the world’s highest-performance founders, athletes, and family offices. Think of it as the operating system for someone’s entire personal life, travel, dining, exclusive experiences, luxury goods, and wellness all managed in one place by a team that genuinely goes the extra mile.

Here’s a concrete example. A member is flying to New York for three days. Their itinerary: check in to the Four Seasons, dinner at Nobu, a visit to the Met.

You call the Four Seasons’ guest relations team, build a quick rapport, and arrange for two bottles of Dom Pérignon to be waiting in the room with a handwritten welcome card from the company.

Nobu is fully booked. You find the right contact, introduce yourself professionally, and get the table anyway - because you know how to talk to people who matter.

You reach out to the Met’s private tours team and arrange for a dedicated art historian to personally guide the member through the galleries, with refreshments waiting.

title: Virtual Executive Assistant
description:
I'm the founder of a digital growth marketing company that helps mission-driven founders scale their businesses with more ease & less overwhelm - and I'm looking for a small team of highly-skilled Executive Assistants to help take over the marketing and management tasks that make a huge difference in the lives of the people that hire us.



I'm looking for a max of 5 amazing executive assistants available for part-time (potential for full time) with a salary starting at $500 USD per month and with long term success and robust training, moving up to $700 USD per month as an emerging leader in the company.



If you have the following skill sets, I encourage you to apply:



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:

- Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in Digital Marketing, Video Editing, Social Media Management, Content Creation, and Executive Assistant Work (Administrative Tasks, Calendar &
 Management, etc)

You’re trusted to manage marketing deliverables while providing high-level executive support, keeping priorities organized, systems moving, and leadership focused on growth instead of day-to-day execution. You've done it all from managing schedules to
 & calendar management. You have a meticulous eye for detail where Prioritization and Organization are your love language



-- 1+ years of experience in Sales Funnels and Shopify

You're a professional who is passionate about helping changemakers simplify their lives by setting up systems that will allow them to operate their businesses with more ease and less overwhelm. You have experience with sales funnel and CRM software



- 1+ years of experience advertising on platforms like Instagram,
, Tik Tok, within a Marketing team consisting of Paid Acquisition, Organic Marketing, Customer Retention, & Product Marketing

You're an emerging leader who has the potential to head a team in the future that will report directly to you. Having leadership experience is a MAJOR plus



- Creating SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures)

You’ll ensure each business function has detailed documentation for repeatable and scalable growth if it isn't already place. If you see gaps, you take the initiative to fill them and produce results without anyone knowing there was an issue (yea, all that and a bag of chips :-)



- Experience working at a digital/online product/platform: You’re familiar with online courses, digital products & platforms and popular tools in the business space ranging from landing page builders and
 service providers to CRMs, and course hosting platforms aren’t foreign to you (We teach tools like Shopify, Convertkit, Kajabi, Teachable, Learnworlds, Calendly, etc)



ABOUT YOU:

- “You down with SOP? Yeah you know me!”—You’re an advocate for SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) to make our systems repeatable & scalable.

- Your love language is processes & predictable, meteoric growth. We never question company progress towards the quarterly and yearly goals because you keep real-time metrics for all projects.

- You’re aware of new software and can look at current systems and identify how to automate tasks a company has been doing manually for months.

- You’re addicted to digital processes & automation in the world of social media because you love building connections in the digital space and you’ve seen how powerful it can be in business growth

- You’re driven by metrics & tracking. You know that you can’t improve something unless you measure it, so you develop ways to measure performance so your company is always predictably improving.

- Timeliness and deadlines are your jam. When we have a team call at 10:00am, you show up at 9:55am. When the deadline is Tuesday at 5:30pm, you have it done Monday.

- You overcommunicate clearly and confidently. If you agree/disagree with something, you communicate that without hesitation or overthinking. You’re no stranger to asking why we do things a certain way to ensure we’re intentional with our resources.

- You’re a leader and team player. Ego? What ego? If something needs to be done, you dive in to make sure all critical tasks are accounted and cared for.

PERKS:

- Task & Calendar Management

- Launch/Sales Strategy Planning

- Sales Funnel Tech Setup (For E-Commerce or Service Based Businesses)

- Social Media Management

- Digital Media Marketing (Including
 and SMS Marketing)

- Lead Generation

- Part time work hours

- Work from anywhere in the world (as long as your internet signal is strong and computer is fast)

title: Operations Executive
description:
About Limitless

We are changing the way sales works. Instead of mass outreach and spam, we act as an instant matchmaking service for our clients, providing them with a pre-built CRM and highly researched, hyper-personalised introductions every single day.



The Role

We are looking for an Operations Executive to join our offshore team. To be completely transparent, this is a highly repetitive, execution-heavy role. You will be the crucial final step in our automated lead generation system. Your primary job will be navigating our internal software, doing quality checks, and clicking through processes to ensure our clients receive their daily leads.

While the physical work is essentially "pressing buttons", the impact is massive. We require absolute perfection in execution; our standard is 100% with no exceptions.



Key Responsibilities

Daily Drip Feeds: Log into client accounts daily to execute the "drip feed" process, sending out 3 to 5 hyper-personalised introductions per client.

System Operation: Generate HTML
s within our platform, copy them into Gmail, and send them to the appropriate targets.

Quality Control (QC): Spend time per lead ensuring that the
 content and the identified stakeholders perfectly match before hitting send.

Accountability: Log every sent
 accurately (including company target and Gmail URL) to keep our daily forecasting and tracking 100?curate.



Requirements

Incredible Attention to Detail: Sending the wrong information to the wrong stakeholder is not an option. You must be meticulous.

Highly "Switched On" & Quick Learner: You need to pick up our proprietary systems quickly and operate them flawlessly.

Process-Driven: You are perfectly comfortable doing repetitive, click-heavy tasks without losing focus or dropping your standards.

Proactive Communicator: If something is broken or a system is down, you flag it immediately rather than waiting to be asked.

Reporting To: Aaron Tang (Founder & CEO)





About the Role



As a Media Buyer, you will be responsible for launching, managing, and optimising paid advertising campaigns for our clients across
 Ads and Google Ads. Your mission is simple: drive consistent lead volume while hitting strong CPL targets.



This is local lead generation, not complex eCommerce. You’ll be running straightforward campaigns (radius targeting, lead forms, direct response) at scale — typically 40+ active campaigns — so efficiency and organisation matter.





Key Responsibilities



Campaign Setup & Launch

 • Build and launch new campaigns for newly 
 clients across
 & Google Ads

 • Configure targeting, budgets, creatives, lead forms, tracking, and campaign structure



Daily Campaign Management

 • Monitor performance daily and make smart optimisations

 • Adjust budgets, pause underperformers, and scale winning ads

 • Maintain clean account structure and ensure campaigns run smoothly



Cost Per Lead (CPL) Optimisation

 • Continuously optimise to reduce CPL and increase lead volume

 • Identify inefficiencies and implement performance improvements quickly



A/B Testing

 • Test ad creatives, copy, audiences, placements, and campaign angles

 • Use testing insights to improve results and prevent creative fatigue



Reporting

 • Track and report key metrics such as CPL, CTR, CPC, frequency, conversion volume

 • Provide clear updates to the internal team and support client reporting needs



Troubleshooting & Problem Solving

 • Diagnose and fix underperformance (low CTR, high CPL, learning limitations)

 • Resolve ad rejections, policy issues, and technical hiccups efficiently



Collaboration

 • Work closely with the Ad Creative Team (images/videos) and CSMs (client requests + feedback)

 • Collaborate with other media buyers to share insights and improve systems





What Success Looks Like (KPIs)



We measure success by results, not hours. Here’s what “winning” looks like:

 • Average CPL: $11–$17

 • Campaign Load: 40+ campaigns managed

 • Ad Approval Rate: ? 95%

 • Internal Response Time: < 2>

If you consistently hit these targets, you can earn $900–$1,400+ per month (base + bonuses).

You’ll report directly to Aaron Tang (Founder & CEO) and collaborate with:

 • Customer Success Managers (CSMs): handle client communication and relay requests/feedback

 • Ad Creative Team: produces ad images and videos for your campaigns

 • Other Media Buyers: collaborate on performance improvements and best practices



Our Clients



Our clients are:

title: Executive Assistant to CEO
description:
Position Overview:



As the Executive Assistant to the CEO, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the smooth and efficient functioning of the executive office. Your primary responsibility will be to provide comprehensive administrative support to the CEO, managing their schedule, and coordinating various tasks to enhance productivity. Your ability to maintain confidentiality, exercise sound judgment, and proactively handle administrative duties will contribute to the overall effectiveness of the CEO's office.





Pay Range: $8 per hour with a performance review scheduled after 90 days of employment. We believe in rewarding exceptional talents.





About Power Plus Systems:



Power Plus Systems LLC has been a dominant force in the residential electrical contracting industry for two decades, and we continue to lead the way. Our vision is to successfully wire 28,000 homes to completion by the year 2029, ensuring safe and efficient electrical solutions, thereby making a positive impact on the lives of our customers and communities. At Power Plus Systems, LLC, a position with us isn't just a job; it's an opportunity to grow and develop within a company that genuinely appreciates your contributions and dedication to our shared mission.





Objectives:

• Manage and organize the CEO's daily schedule, including meetings, appointments, and travel arrangements.

• Act as a gatekeeper, screening and prioritizing communications to the CEO.

• Coordinate and facilitate communication between the CEO and internal/external stakeholders.

• Anticipate the CEO's needs and proactively handle tasks to ensure optimal time management.

• Coordinate special projects and initiatives as assigned by the CEO.





Competencies:

• Exceptional organizational and multitasking skills, with keen attention to detail.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise discretion in handling sensitive information.

• Proficient in using Microsoft Office and Google Suites.

• Familiarity with scheduling software; experience with additional productivity tools is an advantage.

• Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to interact effectively with individuals at all levels.

• Proactive problem solver and resourceful thinker.





Equipment Requirements:

• Must own a reliable computer or laptop capable of handling administrative tasks efficiently.

• Must own and actively use an iPhone and/or MacBook or Mac computer for efficient communication and task management.

• High-speed internet connection to support video calls, cloud-based collaboration, and remote work.





Physical Requirements:

• Extended periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.



Benefits:

• Growth opportunities in a well-established company.

• Ongoing training and professional development opportunities.

• Opportunity for advancement within the company.

• A supportive and collaborative work environment.

• Company-observed paid United States holidays (full time).

• Paid vacation.





How to Apply:



If you are ready to join Power Plus Systems, LLC, a well-established residential electrical contractor that values its tea
mbers and offers excellent benefits, please submit your application through the link below.




/internationalcareers



Power Plus Systems, LLC is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds to apply.



Join us at Power Plus Systems, LLC, and be part of our continued success as we embark on the next 20 years of excellence in residential electrical contracting!

title: AI-Powered Video Editor – Meta Ads (Standby/On-Demand)
description:
???? AI-Powered Video Editor – Freelance (Standby Pool) | Meta Ads & E-commerce Content



???? About Us

AVEN GROUP LLP is a fast-scaling women's fashion e-commerce brand with an international reach and a rapidly growing production operation. We create high-performing video content primarily for Meta Ads, and our creative output is at the heart of our growth engine.

We are currently building a strategic HR reserve — a pool of vetted, ready-to-work freelancers we can activate quickly whenever production demand increases or capacity gaps arise. This is not a standard immediate hire. We are selecting profiles now so we are never caught off guard.

Any collaboration that starts here can evolve into a long-term engagement for the right person.



???? Mission

We are looking for a freelance Video Editor with strong AI skills to join our standby pool.

When activated, your role will be to produce high-converting video ads for Meta, based on scripts provided by our Creative Strategists — content that feels native, real, and brand-consistent.

This is not a role for someone who needs to be taught AI from scratch. You already work with AI tools daily and know how to get results out of them.



?? Your Role

When engaged, you will work within a structured creative team composed of:



Creative Strategists — who provide scripts and creative briefs you'll execute

CEOs / Marketing leads — who validate content quality and strategic relevance

Other editors — for workload coordination when production peaks



Core responsibilities:



Edit video ads (A-roll / B-roll) based on provided scripts

Use AI tools to generate or enhance visual assets (images, video sequences, audio)

Maintain strict product consistency across videos — leggings must look natural, realistic, and on-brand from one video to the next

Apply strong visual judgment to detect AI artifacts, inconsistencies, or anything that breaks realism

Iterate with AI tools until the output genuinely works — not just "looks generated"

Produce occasional static creatives (promotional images) when needed

Deliver content that feels native and relatable — UGC-style, not overproduced





???? What We're Looking For

? Must Have



Solid video editing foundation (Premiere Pro, CapCut, DaVinci, or equivalent)

Hands-on experience with AI tools for production: image generation, video generation, prompting, B-roll creation, audio adjustment

Strong visual judgment — you know when something looks fake, off-brand, or inconsistent

Genuine attention to detail, especially around product appearance and brand consistency

Experience producing content for Meta Ads (Reels, Stories, Feed)

Sensitivity for UGC / native ad content — you understand that controlled imperfection is often more powerful than polish

Ability to work from a script brief and deliver without heavy supervision



? Huge Plus



Experience with fashion or women's activewear brands

Portfolio showing Meta ad content or performance creative

Experience producing AI-generated assets at scale

Ability to adapt quickly to evolving workflows and tools



???? AI Literacy — Required

We are an AI-native production team. You are expected to use Claude and/or ChatGPT as part of your daily workflow — for prompting, iteration, script analysis, and asset generation.

Basic AI literacy is a minimum requirement, not a bonus. You know how to prompt, iterate, and extract real, usable output from AI tools. Ideally, you already integrate AI at every stage of your editing process.



???? What Makes This Opportunity Unique



You join a fast-growing brand with consistent production volume — when activated, the work is real and steady

You work with a structured creative team, not in isolation — scripts, briefs, and feedback loops are already in place

Standby model = flexibility for you, reliability for us — you're not locked in, but you're first in line

Strong performance opens the door to long-term collaboration and increased workload

You'll be part of a team already pushing the boundaries of AI-assisted content production





???? Engagement



Type: Freelance (Upwork)

Model: Standby pool — activated on demand based on production needs

Rate: $4.30–$5.70/hour depending on experience and skill level

Expected load when active: Full-time (~35h/week)

Long-term potential: Yes — strong collaborations evolve naturally





???? How to Apply

Please include the following in your application:



Your experience with AI tools in video production — be specific about which tools and how you use them

Examples of Meta ad content you've edited or produced (links or portfolio)

One example where you had to maintain visual consistency across multiple videos or assets

Your current availability and how quickly you could be ready to start if activated



?? Please start your application with "AVENEDITOR" — applications without this keyword will not be reviewed.



We look forward to building a strong pool of creative talent. If you're the kind of editor who takes pride in the details and already lives inside AI tools, this is built for you.

title: Betting Operations & VM Management Assistant
description:
OPENING STATEMENT



We are looking for a full-time Betting Operations & VM Management Assistant to join a growing Australian professional betting operation.



Your main job will be managing a fleet of Windows virtual machines that run automated betting software. Every day, you will log into each VM using remote desktop tools, check that the betting software is running, confirm that bookmaker accounts are logged in, fix any issues that come up, and keep accurate records of everything. On busy race days (especially Saturdays), you will need to check more often because bookmakers can log out mid-session. You will also help with small admin tasks like signing up to new bookmaker accounts as the operation grows.



If you have experience in online operations, VM management, remote desktop work, data entry, betting admin, or similar detail-heavy technical roles - and you are comfortable doing repetitive work to a high standard every day - we want to hear from you.



WHAT WE OFFER



* Full-time, stable, long-term role with an Australian business.

* 40 hours per week, Wednesday to Sunday.

* 20,000php starting salary during probation. 23,500php + 1,500php benefits post probation (~1month)

* Full training provided on all systems and tools.

* Fully remote - work from home.

* 13th month pay.

* Government-mandated benefits.



WHAT YOU'LL DO (TRAINING PROVIDED)



* Log into Windows virtual machines via remote desktop every day and check that they are running correctly.

* Monitor automated betting software on each VM - confirm sessions are active, bookmakers are logged in, and there are no errors.

* On Saturdays and busy race days, check VMs more frequently to catch bookmakers that log out mid-session.

* Fix common issues - restart frozen VMs, re-log bookmaker accounts, restart betting software sessions.

* Escalate infrastructure-level problems (proxy connections, VPN, server issues) to the technical support team.

* Maintain accurate tracking records - account balances, VM statuses, and operational data.

* Sign up to new bookmaker accounts as instructed, following the exact process provided.

* Provide daily updates to the owner on the state of the operation.



REQUIREMENTS



* Technically proficient - you pick up new software quickly and can troubleshoot basic issues independently.

* Comfortable working inside Windows remote desktop environments for extended periods.

* Strong attention to detail - the same checks across many VMs every day, and accuracy matters.

* Genuinely comfortable with repetitive, routine work done to a high standard.

* Proactive communicator - you raise issues immediately, not later.

* Available to work Wednesday to Sunday, including Saturday mornings from 9:00am AEST.

* Reliable computer and stable internet connection.



NICE TO HAVE



* Prior experience in betting operations, matched betting, or bookmaker account management.

* Experience with automated betting tools.

* Experience using Airtable or similar tracking tools.

* Experience with remote desktop tools (RDM, AnyDesk, TeamViewer).



SCHEDULE

This role suits someone who is technically capable, comfortable with routine, and looking for stable long-term work with an Australian business. If you enjoy keeping systems running, doing detail-heavy work accurately, and being relied on to manage things independently - apply now.

title: Customer Support Team Lead
description:
We’re looking for a Support Team Lead to own day-to-day performance, coaching, and quality across our APAC/EMEA support team. This is a working lead role - You’ll carry your own case queue alongside leading the team.



What makes this role different is the AI layer. Tixel runs an AI support agent that handles and triages a growing volume of customer contacts. Our approach to AI is simple: it’s there to support customers with fast, accurate resolutions and to provide clear paths to a human where it’s really needed. AI supports the team; it doesn’t replace it.



That means this role isn’t just about leading people. It’s about being sharp enough to know when the AI is getting it wrong, why, and what needs to change. You’ll be a key voice in improving how our AI support layer serves customers, through structured QA, documented feedback, and direct input into the knowledge base that powers it.



You’ll report directly to the Global Support Operations Manager (based in Australia).



WHAT YOU’LL DO



Team Leadership & Culture

* Lead a team of 6-7 APAC and EMEA-based support agents - owning their day-to-day performance, development, and wellbeing

* Run structured 1:1s and coaching sessions grounded in QA data, not gut feel.

* Build genuine team culture in a remote, async-first environment where agents feel connected, clear on expectations, are proud of their work and want to actively contribute.

* Lead calmly under pressure during event days, escalation spikes, and peak periods



Case Execution

* Carry an active personal caseload (~60–70% of a standard agent workload) alongside your leadership responsibilities

* Own escalated and high-impact cases — fulfilment failures, payment edge cases, time-sensitive event-day issues

* Hold authority to approve goodwill gestures and exceptions within defined policy limits

* Set the standard for communication quality, case ownership, and follow-through on your team



AI Support Quality & Knowledge

* Conduct weekly structured QA reviews of AI-handled contacts — assessing tone alignment, policy accuracy, resolution quality, and failure patterns

* Document specific failure examples with context and escalate findings to the knowledge base owner with clear recommendations

* Validate knowledge base updates before they go live — flag edge cases and risks before they reach customers

* Participate in QA calibration sessions to maintain scoring consistency across US, APAC and UK/EU

* Bring analytical curiosity to how the AI support layer behaves — you’re not building it, but you’re one of the people responsible for making it better



Agent QA & Coaching

* Be formally accountable for weekly QA scoring of agent-handled contacts using our company rubric framework

* Deliver structured coaching and feedback that is specific, tied to outcomes, and tracked over time

* Identify performance gaps early and resource them appropriately before they become systemic

* Report QA outcomes, performance trends, and coaching progress to Global Support Ops weekly



Operational Monitoring & Roster

* Monitor inbox health, queue volumes, escalation rates, and workflow performance throughout each shift

* Identify emerging trends, product issues, or operational risks early and escalate with documented examples, volume indicators, and recommended actions

* Own the fortnightly roster to ensure coverage meets demand across all queues and peak periods

* Identify capacity gaps in advance — don’t let resourcing risks arrive as service failures



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Experience

* 3+ years in customer support, with at least 1 year in a team lead, senior agent, or QA role

* Demonstrated track record of coaching agents and lifting team performance through structured, evidence-based feedback

* Zendesk experience required

* Exposure to AI support tools or automation-assisted support - you don’t need to build them, but you need to understand how they behave and where they break

* Experience with QA frameworks or rubric-based case evaluation - formal BPO QA background is a strong advantage

* Background in marketplace, e-commerce, ticketing, or payments is highly regarded



Skills & Attributes

* Exceptional written and conversational English — this role is written-first across Zendesk, Slack, and async tools, but may occasionally require customer phone calls

* Analytical mindset — you spot patterns in conversations and data before you’re asked to

* Strong ownership mentality — you identify the problem and move, without waiting to be told

* Comfortable with autonomy in a distributed, async-first environment across time zones

* Calm and decisive under pressure, particularly during event-day peaks

* Genuinely curious about AI in support — not just aware of it, but interested in how it can be improved

* Aligned with our company values: direct, customer-first, accountable and passionate about live experiences



HOW WE WORK

* Remote-first, async-heavy — we communicate in writing, move fast, and don’t schedule meetings for things that can be a message

* OKR-driven with Quarterly planning cycles — your work ladders up to team and company objectives

* Weekly 1:1s with your manager, fortnightly all-hands, regular team rituals that keep distributed teams connected

* Core tooling: Zendesk, Slack, Notion, Google Drive, Zoom — and an AI support layer you’ll actively help manage

* Willingness to work weekends, public holidays, and peak event periods is essential for this role

mber in you.

Are you a strategic, data-driven Amazon operator with a passion for optimization and brand growth?

Accountability & Ownership

Implement CRO strategies and coordinate ongoing A/B tests

Coordinate freelancers and vendors (designers, photographers, copywriters, content creators)

Monitor and improve brand health metrics: rankings, reviews, CTR, CR, Buy Box, etc.

Ensure Amazon account hygiene: compliance, suppressed listings, variations, flat files (as needed), category attributes, and policy adherence



Daily & Weekly Tasks

Perform ongoing listing audits and implement improvements (titles, bullets, images, backend, A+, attributes)

Analyze competitors for positioning and conversion opportunities (without product scouting)

Track performance: sessions, conversion rate, CTR, sales rank, review velocity, return rate

Collaborate with PPC, supply chain, and creative teams to align:

Listing updates with ad strategy

Inventory levels with promo and demand forecasts

Creative needs with conversion goals

Manage reporting and ensure action items are executed consistently



Long-Term Projects & Goals

Build a consistent, strategic brand identity across all customer touchpoints on Amazon

Create a repeatable system for ongoing listing improvement and CRO

Improve customer loyalty and retention through stronger messaging, brand voice, and content

Develop SOPs for listing updates, creative briefs, review management, and performance reporting



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

KPI 1: Listing Quality & Organic Performance

Objective: Improve listing visibility and discoverability through optimization



Metrics:

Keyword indexing coverage + organic rank improvements

CTR improvements (Search + ads-supported)

Reduction in suppressed/invalid attributes and listing issues

Actions:

Run keyword research and update listings using Helium 10 + market analysis

Maintain listing audit checklist and optimization tracker

Monitor indexing, rank trends, and category attribute completeness



KPI 2: Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)

Objective: Improve conversion rate through data-backed iteration

Metric: Conversion Rate (%) from Amazon Business Reports

Actions:

Optimize copy, images, A+ content, and brand story

Run split tests where possible (ManageByStats, Splitly, Experiments, or equivalent)

Monitor behavior signals (CTR, CVR, returns, reviews) and iterate



KPI 3: Brand Health & Customer Trust

Objective: Improve brand reputation and customer experience

Metrics:

Review rating + review velocity

Return rate trends and top return reasons

Q&A hygiene and listing clarity improvements

Actions:

Review monitoring + recurring issue reporting

Coordinate content updates to address objections/returns

Strengthen product education via visuals + A+ modules

Qualifications & Skills



Required

3+ years managing private label brands on Amazon (account management / listing optimization

Deep understanding of Amazon SEO and algorithm fundamentals

Strong experience with Helium 10, keyword research, and listing optimization

Proven ability to brief and coordinate creatives (designers, copywriters, photographers)

Familiarity with A+ content, storefront management, and conversion tracking

Strong operational discipline: can manage tasks, trackers, and deadlines without hand-holding



Preferred

Background in marketing, branding, or e-commerce growth strategy

Experience with CRO/testing platforms (e.g., ManageByStats, Splitly, Amazon Experiments)

Experience using Asana, Notion, or Trello for project management

Understanding of PPC’s relationship to CTR/CVR and organic rank (coordination-level, not necessarily hands-on media buying)



Soft Skills

Ownership mentality and high attention to detail

Strong marketing instincts and customer-centric thinking

Excellent written and verbal English communication

Organized, proactive, and reliable

Analytical mindset — able to turn data into decisions



What We Offer

Competitive rates

Fully remote

Bi-weekly payments and performance reviews

Long-term role with growth potential

Paid leave and additional benefits after 6 months (SSS, Pag-ibig, health insurance)

Supportive team culture with room for innovation and contribution

Training resources and personal development opportunities



How to Apply

Include in subject line: “[Your Favorite Book] - Amazon Account / Brand Manager Application”

Attach your updated resume

Include a short video (2–3 min) introducing yourself and describing your:

Experience optimizing Amazon listings and improving conversion rates

Tools you’ve used and how you used them

A specific listing improvement you made and the result (CTR/CVR/rank/reviews)

Complete the internet speed test from speedtest.net and attach a screenshot

Attach a screenshot with your computer specs



Why Join Us?

This is more than just account management. It’s an opportunity to take ownership of Amazon performance, strengthen a real brand, and build systems that scale. If you’re driven by impact, autonomy, and measurable outcomes, we’d love to meet you.

title: Senior GL Accountant (US Focus)
description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior GL Accountant to support US-focused accounting and finance operations within a fast-paced and high-performance environment.



The ideal candidate has strong experience in general ledger accounting, month-end close, reconciliations, and financial reporting, with a solid understanding of US GAAP and multi-entity accounting operations.



This role is ideal for accounting professionals who are confident working independently, partnering cross-functionally, and operating within process-driven finance environments that value accuracy, accountability, and continuous improvement.



Who This Role Is For



We are looking for professionals who thrive in:

• US accounting environments

• Multi-entity operations

• Cross-functional finance teams

• High-volume and fast-paced close cycles

• Process-driven accounting environments

• Roles requiring strong ownership and accountability



Role Overview



The Senior GL Accountant will take ownership of key accounting functions including:

• General ledger management

• Month-end and year-end close

• Financial reporting support

• Balance sheet reconciliations

• Audit preparation and compliance

• Process improvement initiatives



Depending on business needs, the role may also support multi-entity reporting structures and cross-functional finance operations.



Key Responsibilities

General Ledger & Close

• Own and manage assigned general ledger accounts

• Prepare and review journal entries including:

Accruals

Deferrals

Depreciation

Amortization

Reclassifications

Revenue and expense adjustments



• Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual close activities

• Perform and review balance sheet reconciliations and bank reconciliations

• Investigate and resolve reconciling items promptly

• Maintain accurate supporting schedules and audit-ready workpapers

• Ensure completeness and accuracy of financial records



Financial Reporting & Analysis

• Support preparation of monthly financial reports and supporting schedules

• Perform variance and flux analysis with clear explanations

• Assist with management reporting and ad hoc financial analysis

• Ensure proper cutoff and period-end accuracy



Technical Accounting & Compliance

• Ensure compliance with US GAAP and company accounting policies

• Support internal and external audit activities

• Maintain strong internal controls and documentation standards

• Review transactions for proper accounting treatment

• Assist in implementing accounting process improvements and best practices



Multi-Entity & Cross-Functional Support

• Support intercompany and multi-entity reconciliations

• Handle multi-currency transactions and FX adjustments

• Coordinate closely with AP, AR, Payroll, FP&A, and Operations teams

• Act as point of contact for assigned entities or business units



Process Improvement

• Identify opportunities to streamline and improve accounting workflows

• Support close acceleration and accounting optimization initiatives

• Assist in documenting accounting procedures and SOPs

• Support ERP and finance system enhancement projects



Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting or Finance

• Strong understanding of US GAAP

• Minimum 5+ years of progressive accounting experience

• Proven ownership of month-end close processes

• Strong experience with general ledger accounting and reconciliations

• Hands-on ERP experience (NetSuite or similar preferred)

• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Excellent attention to detail and organizational ability

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Ability to work independently and meet deadlines effectively



Preferred Qualifications

• CPA or equivalent certification is a strong advantage

• Experience supporting US-based companies

• Multi-entity and intercompany accounting exposure

• SOX/internal controls experience is an advantage

• Public accounting background is a plus

• Experience mentoring or reviewing work of junior accountants is an advantage

• Experience working within high-growth or fast-paced environments is preferred



Application Instructions



To be considered for this position, please submit the following:



• Your application letter

• Unrestricted link to your updated resume/CV



Subject Line:



USSrGLAcct – YOUR FULL NAME



Only applicants who meet the required qualifications will be contacted.

title: AP/AR Accountant – Finance Ops (US Focus)
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented, proactive, and ownership-driven AP/AR Accountant – Finance Ops to support US-focused accounting and finance operations within a fast-paced, high-performance environment.



While the role includes core Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable responsibilities, this position is also heavily focused on Finance Operations support, issue resolution, process ownership, and cross-functional coordination.



This is not a purely transactional accounting role. We are looking for someone who can independently manage workflows, proactively resolve accounting and operational issues, identify process gaps, and help improve overall finance operations with minimal supervision.



The ideal candidate has strong experience in AP/AR operations, reconciliations, billing, collections, payment tracking, and financial transaction processing, along with the ability to work cross-functionally and thrive in a fast-paced environment.



This role is ideal for accounting professionals who are highly organized, process-driven, solutions-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of responsibilities from start to finish.



Who This Role Is For

We are looking for professionals who thrive in:

• US accounting and finance environments

• AP/AR and finance operations roles

• Fast-paced and high-volume operations

• Ownership-driven environments with minimal handholding

• Roles requiring accountability, initiative, and problem-solving

• Cross-functional operational support

• Process improvement and issue resolution



Role Overview

The AP/AR Accountant – Finance Ops will support and take ownership of key accounting and finance functions including:

• Accounts Payable operations

• Accounts Receivable management

• Billing and invoicing

• Reconciliations and payment tracking

• Collections and issue resolution

• Financial operations support

• Cross-functional finance coordination

• Process improvement initiatives



Depending on business needs, the role may also support multi-entity accounting operations, reporting activities, and month-end close processes.



Key Responsibilities

Finance Operations & Ownership

• Take ownership of assigned AP/AR and finance workflows

• Proactively identify, investigate, and resolve accounting or operational discrepancies

• Manage finance-related issues through resolution with minimal supervision

• Ensure accuracy, completeness, and timeliness across financial transactions

• Help improve finance operations and internal workflows



Accounts Payable

• Process vendor invoices accurately and efficiently

• Review invoices for coding accuracy and approvals

• Prepare and manage payment runs

• Resolve vendor inquiries and invoice discrepancies independently

• Monitor AP aging reports and outstanding balances



Accounts Receivable

• Generate and issue customer invoices

• Monitor customer balances and incoming payments

• Handle collections follow-ups and payment tracking

• Resolve billing discrepancies and customer account issues

• Maintain accurate AR aging schedules and records



Reconciliations & Reporting

• Perform bank, vendor, and customer reconciliations

• Support month-end close and reporting activities related to AP/AR

• Maintain supporting schedules and accounting documentation

• Assist with audit requests and financial data validation



Cross-Functional Support

• Collaborate closely with Accounting, Operations, Payroll, and Finance teams

• Support intercompany and multi-entity transaction processing

• Assist with ERP/accounting system workflows and improvements

title: Amazon PPC Manager
description:
# Amazon PPC Manager (Only Zest) — JD



**Location:** Remote, Philippines-based

**Type:** Full-time

**Salary:** $800 - $1,000 USD/month based on experience, BEFORE performance bonus

**Hours:** Mon-Fri 12pm-10pm SGT (GMT+8), 30 min lunch break. 44 hrs/week, 176 hrs/month.



---



Only Zest is a Singapore-based Amazon FBA brand selling paper-based consumer products. We're doing approximately 7-figures annualised on Amazon US, with 30+ active ASINs and ~$39K/month in ad spend.



We are scaling the Amazon side and need an Amazon PPC Manager to own, optimise, and scale our advertising across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display. You will work alongside our existing PPC operations and our AI Performance Director (Rex) who runs weekly portfolio analysis.



## Role overview

You will drive profitable growth using tools like Helium 10, Scale Insights, and DataDive, while building SOPs that make results repeatable. The single most important metric we're tracking: getting our TACoS down from 32% to 20% within 18 months by getting paid spend to compound into organic rank.



This is for a results-oriented operator who works with minimal supervision and wants to grow alongside a high-performing team.



## Key responsibilities

- Manage, optimise, and scale Amazon PPC campaigns across 30+ active ASINs to hit ACoS and TACoS targets

- Analyse performance metrics (CTR, CVR, ACoS, TACoS, ROAS) and present clear actionable insights

- Develop and execute keyword and targeting strategies (branded, competitor, category, PAT, defence)

- Use automation tools to streamline campaign optimisation and scaling

- Build and maintain SOPs for consistency, efficiency, and future team scaling

- Drive high-quality traffic efficiently to product listings to maximise ROI

- Familiarise yourself with SEO, listing optimisation, and keyword targeting so you know what to aim for

- Work alongside an AI Performance Director (Rex) that already runs weekly diagnostics, so you can focus on execution and judgement, not dashboard building



## What we are looking for

- **3 to 4 years** of hands-on Amazon PPC management with proven success in scaling campaigns

- Strong analytical mindset and deep understanding of Amazon advertising metrics

- Skilled in Excel or Google Sheets for performance tracking

- Familiarity with tools like Scale Insights, Helium 10, and DataDive

- Strategic thinker who can balance growth goals with daily optimisations

- Goal-oriented, proactive, comfortable working with minimal supervision

- **Fluent with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) as part of your daily workflow.** We use AI internally as a force multiplier and we want to see how you leverage it. Equally important: you can spot when AI is wrong and push back. We do not want AI sycophants.



## What you will bring

- A results-driven approach focused on profitable growth

- Clear communication and the ability to present insights simply

- Proactive problem-solving: you anticipate and fix issues early

- Passion for staying ahead of Amazon's evolving ad platform

- Team-oriented mindset, you want to build the company together



## Application instructions, read carefully

To be considered you must include all four of the following or your application will be skipped:

1. Put the word **AMAZON** at the very top of your reply

2. Your CV or resume

3. A short video introduction explaining why you are a great fit for this role

4. Your current status: why you are leaving your last job, or what you were doing just before applying



Applications with video introductions will be prioritised. Applications missing any of the above will not be entertained.



We screen the application's screening questions HARD. Generic, AI-sounding, or vague answers are auto-rejected. We're only interested in candidates who can think and write specifically.



## Important note

This is not an entry-level position. If you are new to the workforce or lack relevant Amazon PPC experience, please do not apply.



## Stage 2 (for shortlisted candidates only) — AI Co-Pilot Test

A **single 60-minute live working session** over Zoom or Google Meet. We pay **US$10** on completion regardless of outcome.



How it works:

- We hand you a real anonymised OZ portfolio snapshot (30 ASINs, ad spend, ACoS, TACoS, inventory, CVR)

- Your job: identify the 3 biggest opportunities for next week

- **AI use is mandatory.** Use Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, your choice. You must share your screen the entire time so we can see how you direct AI.

- At the end, you present your 3 opportunities. We ask follow-up questions, including: "Which AI suggestion did you reject and why?"



We're not testing whether you know PPC, we're testing how you think with AI as your co-pilot, what you catch that AI misses, and how you push back when AI is wrong. There is no preparation needed.



---



Best regards,

Jerald

Only Zest
