title: Shopify & eBay eCommerce Content and Catalogue Manager
description:
The Shopify & eBay eCommerce Content and Catalogue Manager is responsible for the accuracy, structure, optimisation, and performance of Uniqleen’s online product catalogue across Shopify and eBay.



This role owns product data integrity, product content creation, product listings, collection/category structure, on-site SEO execution, internal linking, digital merchandising, and eBay inventory/listing management to improve search visibility, navigation clarity, customer experience, and conversion performance.



Uniqleen is primarily a B2C eCommerce business, with a less complex setup than a large B2B catalogue, but the role still requires strong attention to detail, strong Shopify experience, strong product content skills, and the ability to manage product information consistently across multiple sales channels.



This role also requires the ability to use AI tools responsibly as part of a controlled eCommerce content workflow, including drafting, rewriting, improving, checking, and scaling product content without compromising accuracy, originality, or product data integrity.



* This is not a social media or paid ads role.

* This is not a developer role.

* This is a catalogue, content, marketplace, structure, and optimisation role.

* This role includes Shopify catalogue management, product content creation, and eBay listing/inventory management.

* This role requires strong quality control over all manually written and AI-assisted product content.



Key Responsibilities



1. Product & Catalogue Management

* Create, update, and maintain product listings across Shopify and eBay, including titles, descriptions, bullet points, variants, images, PDFs, specifications, pricing, and inventory information.

* Manage product data in bulk using Shopify CSVs or third-party tools such as Matrixify/Excelify where required.

* Maintain accurate product titles, descriptions, images, SKUs, barcodes, pricing, stock status, tags, metafields, and product categorisation.

* Manage product variants such as sizes, colours, pack quantities, fragrances, bundle options, or other relevant variations.

* Ensure product information is consistent, accurate, and customer-friendly across all sales channels.

* Maintain clear naming conventions that align with SEO, customer search behaviour, and internal catalogue structure.

* Prevent duplicate products, inconsistent URLs, incorrect variants, and duplicated listing content.

* Ensure discontinued, out-of-stock, or replaced products are handled correctly across Shopify and eBay.

* Maintain catalogue accuracy across product names, specifications, pack sizes, product types, usage details, and channel-specific listing requirements.



2. Product Content Creation & Optimisation

* Write, edit, and optimise product titles, descriptions, bullet points, specifications, and SEO metadata for Shopify and eBay.

* Create clear, accurate, customer-friendly product content that explains product type, key benefits, pack size, usage, compatibility, and important specifications.

* Ensure product copy is suitable for B2C customers and written in a way that supports both search visibility and conversion.

* Adapt product content appropriately between Shopify and eBay, ensuring eBay listings include strong titles, item specifics, marketplace-friendly descriptions, and relevant keywords.

* Maintain a consistent tone, structure, and naming convention across the product catalogue.

* Rewrite supplier/manufacturer content into clean, original, useful product copy while avoiding duplicate content and unsupported claims.

* Ensure all product claims, technical details, safety information, dimensions, sizes, ingredients, compatibility, and pack information are checked against reliable source material before publishing.

* Create and maintain content templates for different product types to keep product pages consistent and scalable.

* Ensure product descriptions and bullet points are useful, factual, easy to scan, and aligned with customer buying intent.

* Improve existing product content where descriptions are thin, duplicated, unclear, overly technical, or not optimised for customer search behaviour.



3. AI-Assisted eCommerce Content Workflow

* Use AI tools responsibly to support product content creation, SEO optimisation, bulk content drafting, title refinement, description rewriting, bullet point generation, keyword expansion, and catalogue clean-up.

* Create effective AI prompts and workflows that produce structured, accurate, brand-appropriate eCommerce content.

* Review, edit, fact-check, and improve AI-generated content before publishing.

* Use AI to increase efficiency without compromising accuracy, originality, compliance, or product data integrity.

* Avoid publishing unverified AI-generated claims, incorrect specifications, duplicated content, generic low-value copy, or unsupported product statements.

* Maintain human quality control over all AI-assisted product content.

* Use AI to improve workflow efficiency while still relying on verified product data, supplier information, manufacturer specifications, and internal catalogue standards.

* Build repeatable content workflows for scaling product updates across large batches of products while maintaining accuracy and consistency.



4. Shopify Collection & Site Architecture

* Build and maintain logical Shopify collection structures.

* Optimise categories and collections for customer navigation and search engine indexing.

* Create and manage smart collections, manual collections, product filters, and tags.

* Maintain internal linking between related products, categories, and collections.

* Improve navigation and product discovery across the website.

* Ensure best-selling, seasonal, promotional, and high-priority products are merchandised effectively.

* Monitor and improve collection layouts to support conversion and customer browsing behaviour.

* Maintain clean taxonomy across products, collections, product types, tags, and filters.





5. eBay Listing & Inventory Management

* Create, update, and optimise eBay product listings.

* Ensure eBay titles, item specifics, categories, images, descriptions, pricing, postage details, and returns information are accurate and competitive.

* Manage eBay inventory accuracy, including stock availability, SKU matching, and listing status.

* Monitor overselling risks and ensure Shopify/eBay stock levels remain aligned where applicable.

* Update eBay listings for price changes, discontinued items, new products, bundle changes, or promotional updates.

* Maintain consistency between Shopify product data and eBay listing content.

* Optimise eBay listings using relevant keywords, item specifics, and category best practices.

* Identify and resolve eBay listing errors, suppressed listings, policy issues, duplicate listings, and inventory discrepancies.

* Support eBay marketplace performance by improving listing quality, visibility, and customer-facing product information.

* Ensure Shopify SKUs and eBay SKUs are correctly mapped where inventory sync or channel integration tools are used.



6. On-Site SEO Execution

* Optimise Shopify product titles, meta descriptions, URLs, headings, and product copy.

* Identify keyword opportunities relevant to B2C customer search intent.

* Improve product and collection content for organic search visibility.

* Manage redirects for discontinued, renamed, or replaced products.

* Avoid duplicate content and poor URL structures.

* Collaborate on structured data/schema improvements using Shopify apps or theme settings where required.

* Ensure product content is clear, useful, and aligned with both SEO and customer buying intent.

* Improve thin, duplicated, or manufacturer-supplied product content to better support organic search performance.



7. Digital Merchandising

* Optimise collection layouts and product ordering.

* Improve cross-sell, upsell, related product, and bundle logic.

* Highlight popular products, value packs, seasonal products, new arrivals, and promotional ranges.

* Monitor product visibility within Shopify collections and eBay search results.

* Improve customer product discovery through clear categories, filters, tags, and related product links.

* Ensure product pages clearly communicate key selling points, pack sizes, usage information, specifications, and benefits.

* Support sales performance by improving product presentation and catalogue structure.

* Identify opportunities to improve product pages through better images, clearer copy, stronger bullet points, improved specifications, and better related-product logic.



8. Performance Monitoring

Use Shopify Analytics, GA4, eBay Seller Hub, and other relevant reporting tools to:

* Monitor product performance.

* Identify underperforming products, collections, and eBay listings.

* Improve product page engagement and conversion rates.

* Track traffic, bounce rate, engagement, add-to-cart rate, and product discovery issues.

* Identify gaps in product content, images, titles, pricing, or listing quality.

* Recommend structured improvements based on data.

* Monitor stock-related performance issues, such as out-of-stock products affecting sales.

* Review the impact of product content updates, catalogue improvements, and eBay listing optimisation.



9. App, Backend & Channel Management

* Manage Shopify apps related to product data, SEO, reviews, search, filtering, feeds, inventory, or merchandising.

* Support Shopify/eBay integration tools where applicable.

* Test product, price, inventory, content, or app updates before publishing.

* Coordinate with developers or external support where required.

* Understand Shopify backend limitations and marketplace requirements without needing to perform custom development.

* Maintain clean product data feeds where required for marketplace or shopping channel use.

* Troubleshoot product sync, inventory sync, or listing feed issues between Shopify and eBay.

* Use bulk-editing tools and structured data workflows to reduce manual product management errors.





Required Experience

* Minimum 4–5 years hands-on Shopify experience required.

* Minimum 5–7 years total eCommerce experience preferred.

* Experience managing eBay listings and marketplace inventory required.

* Experience managing medium to large product catalogues, ideally 500+ SKUs.

* Proven experience writing and optimising product titles, descriptions, bullet points, specifications, and SEO metadata for eCommerce.

* Ability to turn supplier/manufacturer information into clear, original, customer-friendly product content.

* Experience using AI tools to assist with eCommerce content creation, catalogue optimisation, SEO copywriting, product description rewriting, or bulk product content workflows.

* Strong ability to review, edit, fact-check, and quality-control AI-assisted content before publication.

* Understanding of how to use AI efficiently without relying on it blindly or publishing inaccurate product information.

* Strong understanding of Shopify product architecture, variants, collections, tags, metafields, and redirects.

* Experience using Shopify CSVs or bulk product management tools such as Matrixify/Excelify.

* Strong understanding of eBay listing optimisation, item specifics, categories, inventory accuracy, and marketplace listing standards.

* Experience maintaining product content across multiple eCommerce channels.

* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage product data accurately.

* Good understanding of SEO basics for product and category pages.

* Strong structural thinking and catalogue/taxonomy understanding.

* Ability to identify product data issues and improve catalogue consistency.

* Experience with GA4, Shopify Analytics, Google Search Console, and eBay Seller Hub preferred.





Not Expected



This role does NOT include:

* Custom Shopify theme development.

* Paid advertising management.

* Social media management.

* Advanced technical SEO or server-side SEO.

* Full UX redesign ownership.

*
 marketing automation.

* Graphic design from scratch.

* Customer service ownership.

* Warehouse operations ownership.

* Custom coding or app development.

* Publishing AI-generated content without review, fact-checking, or human editing.

* Making unsupported claims about product performance, ingredients, safety, certifications, or compatibility.

* Using AI as a replacement for product knowledge, catalogue accuracy, or proper QA.





KPIs for This Role

1. Catalogue Accuracy & Integrity

* Less than 1% product data error rate.

* 100% compliance with agreed naming convention standards.

* Zero duplicate products, duplicate URLs, or avoidable listing conflicts introduced.

* All new products published within agreed SLA, for example 48 hours.

* Accurate product data maintained across Shopify and eBay.

* Correct SKU, variant, price, image, stock, and category data across all active listings.

* Reduced number of product content, variant, image, pricing, or inventory errors after publishing.



2. Product Content Quality

* Product titles, descriptions, bullet points, and metadata follow agreed content structure and naming conventions.

* Product copy is accurate, original, customer-friendly, and SEO-aware.

* Zero unsupported product claims introduced through manual or AI-assisted writing.

* Reduced duplicate manufacturer copy across Shopify and eBay listings.

* Improved product page engagement, click-through rate, and conversion rate after content optimisation.

* AI-assisted workflows improve content output speed without reducing accuracy or catalogue quality.

* Product descriptions and bullet points clearly communicate product use, pack size, benefits, specifications, and customer-relevant details.



3. Shopify SEO & Site Structure Improvement

* Growth in non-branded organic traffic.

* Improvement in indexed product and collection pages without duplication.

* Improved category and collection ranking positions.

* Clean redirect mapping for discontinued or replaced products.

* Reduction in duplicate, thin, or poorly structured product content.

* Improved collection/category navigation and filtering accuracy.

* Improved internal linking between relevant products and collections.



4. eBay Listing & Inventory Performance

* Accurate eBay stock levels with minimal overselling or stock mismatch issues.

* Reduction in eBay listing errors, suppressed listings, or incomplete item specifics.

* Improved eBay listing visibility through better titles, item specifics, and categories.

* Faster turnaround time for new eBay listing creation and updates.

* Consistent pricing, product information, images, and SKUs between Shopify and eBay.

* Improved sell-through rate on optimised eBay listings.

* Reduced number of duplicate, outdated, or incorrectly mapped eBay listings.



5. Conversion & Merchandising Metrics

* Improvement in Shopify collection conversion rate.

* Improvement in product page engagement time.

* Increased cross-sell or related product attachment rate.

* Improved performance of featured products, bundles, seasonal products, and promotional ranges.

* Reduced bounce rate from poorly structured product or collection pages.

* Improved customer navigation and product discovery.

* Improved add-to-cart rate on optimised product pages.



6. Operational Efficiency

* Reduced time to publish new products.

* High accuracy of bulk uploads and product imports.

* Clean metafield, tag, SKU, and collection structure compliance.

* Reduction in manual rework caused by product data errors.

* Faster identification and correction of Shopify or eBay catalogue issues.

* Clear process for product updates across Shopify and eBay.

* Improved speed and consistency of content creation through controlled AI-assisted workflows.



Test: Questions for Candidates to Answer

1. We need to update the price, product title, and a custom product specification field for 800 SKUs in Shopify. Which tool or method would you use to do this accurately, and how would you verify the data before publishing it live?

2. A product is listed on Shopify and eBay with the same SKU, but the stock quantity is showing differently across both channels. What steps would you take to investigate and fix the issue?

3. How would you optimise an eBay listing for a cleaning product to improve visibility and conversion? Please explain how you would approach the title, item specifics, category, images, and description.

4. If we discontinue a high-traffic product on Shopify, what steps would you take to protect Google rankings and avoid customers landing on a 404 page?

5. How do you use AI tools in eCommerce content creation? Please describe your workflow from prompt to final published product copy.

6. What checks would you complete before publishing a new product live on both Shopify and eBay?

7. Please rewrite the following rough supplier product information into a customer-friendly Shopify product title, short description, and 5 bullet points. Explain what information you would not include unless verified.

title: GoHighLevel Operator
description:
Live and work inside GoHighLevel (GHL) every day leveraging its full all-in-one platform to design, build, and ship sustainable paths of revenue for the business. You will operate as a HighLevel-native builder: using the CRM, pipelines, workflow automations, funnel and website builders, calendars, AI Employee suite (Voice AI, Conversation AI, Reviews AI, Content AI, Workflow AI, Funnel AI), social planner, ad manager, e-commerce store, courses, communities, reputation management, invoicing, and SaaS-mode tools to develop production-quality systems, automated marketing engines, and revenue-generating offers; all through a disciplined plan-first, build-once-deploy-everywhere, snapshot-driven workflow. 



Convert GoHighLevel's capabilities into recurring, compounding revenue streams: automated lead-gen and nurture pipelines and AI-powered booking and reactivation campaigns are examples of ways you will bring in revenue daily. You will turn GoHighLevel into a self-perpetuating revenue engine; one that ships new income-producing automations and funnels every single week and gets more profitable over time.



Compensation: Upon starting, you will go through training, and during the training phase the base pay is $3 an hour. This training period is truly based upon how well you produce. If you are bringing in revenue and very productive at the start, you will move to the next training level, which is $6 an hour. If you easily excel at this level, then you move past training and go to the base rate of $12 an hour. From there, you become the leader of this division, and will be given a salaried position of $3000 a month, with seasonal bonuses and a bi-annual salary raises.

title: WANTED! The Worlds Fastest Ad Video Editor
description:
When you apply, please make sure the subject line of your reply is:

"I actually read the instructions"



----------------------------------------



WHO WE ARE



We're DTC LABS — a small startup team with serious experience and drive in e-commerce, paid media, and physical products.



We used to operate as a holding company with multiple brands. Now we're laser-focused on a single brand and we're scaling it to $100M over the next few years.



You'll work directly with the founders. No middle managers, no waiting on permission. Just briefs, edits, feedback, and ship.



----------------------------------------



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Someone who's fast, detail-obsessed, and eager to learn. You take feedback without flinching and apply it the same day. You adapt quickly — we're constantly testing new AI tools and the editors who win here are the ones who pick them up fastest. Speed matters, but sloppy doesn't ship.



----------------------------------------



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



- Edit 3-4 short-form UGC-style ads per day (15-90 sec) for Meta and TikTok

- Edit 1 long-form video (VSL, infomercial, testimonial — 3-7 min) every 2-3 days

- Source supporting clips from TikTok, YouTube, and stock libraries

- Use the latest AI tools (we'll provide training — we're at the edge of what AI can do for editing)

- Implement revision feedback within the same day

- Track your work in Notion and upload finals to 
c using our naming convention



----------------------------------------



QUALIFICATIONS



- Proficient in Premiere Pro and CapCut (we use CapCut across the company)

- 2+ years editing experience, ideally with paid social

- Strong written English

- Portfolio showing UGC-style ads OR long-form VSLs (ideally both)

- Available for 3-hour daily overlap with 15:00-18:00 Europe/Athens time



----------------------------------------



COMPENSATION AND GROWTH



Base: Starting from $1,300 USD/month (40 hrs/week)

Bonuses: Down the line, $500+/month in performance bonuses for ads that hit KPIs



Growth path:

- Top performers grow into senior and lead roles as the company scales

- We promote from within. Always.



----------------------------------------



SUCCESSFUL VIDEO EDITOR PERSONALITY PROFILE



You care more about whether the ad converts than whether it wins a design award. You break your head brainstorming hooks that force people to stop scrolling — not the lazy kind, the kind that actually work. You take blunt feedback without flinching, ship fast, and iterate faster. Tight deadlines energize you instead of stressing you out.



----------------------------------------



MAKE SURE YOU'RE COMFORTABLE WITH...



- Remote working: This is a remote (work-from-home) position. If you don't have a quiet environment with reliable power and internet, this isn't the right role.

- 30-day trial period: All offers start with a 30-day trial. If you're in a comfortable job, don't quit unless you're confident in your ability to perform.

- Fast revision cycles: Sometimes 3 rounds in a day. Constructive feedback comes directly and quickly.

- Output-only environment: We don't care about hours — we care about output. This is a demanding environment where what you ship is what counts.

- Camera on for our weekly call.



----------------------------------------



OUR VALUES



1. COMMUNICATION AND FEEDBACK

Clear and fast. You implement specific feedback within hours, not days. We don't bury problems; we surface them.



2. SPEED

Deadlines are tight, priorities shift, urgency is the default. We'd rather ship and iterate than polish and miss the window — but speed without craft is just sloppy, and sloppy doesn't ship.



3. PERFORMANCE

Aesthetics don't pay; conversions do. Every cut is a decision in service of a metric.



----------------------------------------



TO APPLY



Reply to this job post with ALL of the following:



1. Subject line of your reply must be exactly: "I actually read the instructions"



2. A link to your resume as a PDF, named exactly: Lastname.Firstname.VideoEditor.pdf

(Example: Smith.John.VideoEditor.pdf — host it on Google Drive, Dropbox, or similar, and paste the link.)



3. A link to your portfolio (3-5 best ad-style edits, ideally DTC or UGC).



4. Your favorite ad you've ever edited. Paste the link and write 2-3 sentences explaining why it worked.



Take your time. Applications that skip any of the 4 items above will not be reviewed.



----------------------------------------



CLOSE



We're building something rare here — a small team punching way above its weight, with a real shot at building one of the next big DTC brands. If that sounds like the kind of place you've been looking for, we want to hear from you.



If something about the role or the instructions doesn't make sense, include your question with your application.



George

title: Amazon Operations Manager (FBA / Seller Central)
description:
Amazon Supply Chain & Operations Manager 

Work: Full-time (remote)

Schedule: US EST Hours



We are looking for a highly capable Amazon Supply Chain & Operations Manager to help lead and run our Amazon USA private label business.



This is a hands-on role that combines team oversight and direct execution. It is roughly 50% manager / 50% individual contributor. We need someone who can lead a small team, make sound operational decisions, and also step in directly to solve issues when needed.



This role sits at the center of our operations — from China supplier production, to freight and customs coordination, to 3PL management, to Amazon FBA inventory flow, to Amazon Seller Central account health and operational issue resolution.



This is not a light coordination role. We are looking for someone who understands Amazon operations deeply and can take real ownership.



What You’ll Be Responsible For

>Oversee end-to-end supply chain and operations for our Amazon USA private label business

>Manage inventory flow from suppliers in China to 3PL warehouses in the USA and into Amazon FBA

>Monitor inventory levels and help prevent both stockouts and excess inventory

>Build, manage, and improve monthly and seasonal demand forecasts

>Support purchasing and replenishment decisions based on sales trends, forecasts, and operational constraints

>Step in directly during critical operational periods to help solve logistics issues, customs clearance problems, inbound delays, or other supply chain disruptions

>Manage Amazon Seller Central operational workflows as needed

>Own or help resolve Amazon account health issues, including policy violations, IP complaints, and compliance-related issues

>Coordinate closely with internal teams so inventory planning stays aligned with PPC and business needs

>Monitor product listings, rankings, and competitor activity to help maintain marketplace competitiveness

>Work with suppliers, freight forwarders, and 3PL partners, including issue escalation when needed

>Oversee purchasing activities and help ensure cost-efficiency, strong execution, and on-time delivery

>Manage and mentor a small operations team of 2–3 people

>Help establish clear processes, KPIs, and accountability across the team

>Contribute to process improvement and support other operational or analytical projects as business needs evolve



What We’re Looking For

1. 3+ years of hands-on experience in Amazon operations, supply chain, or logistics within an Amazon environment

2. Strong experience with Amazon FBA, 3PL operations, and international shipping

3. Solid understanding of China-to-USA supply chain flow, including freight forwarding and customs-related coordination

4. Proven experience in forecasting, inventory planning, and demand analysis

5. Hands-on experience using Amazon Seller Central

6. Experience handling Amazon account health, including policy violations, IP complaints, and compliance issues

7. Strong attention to detail, strong judgment, and the ability to solve issues quickly and calmly

8. Highly organized and process-driven

9. Comfortable in a fast-paced, high-responsibility environment

9. Strong English communication skills

10. Strong Google Sheets / Excel skills

11. Comfortable working U.S. East Coast hours



Nice to Have

Experience launching new products on Amazon

Familiarity with tools like Helium 10, SoStocked, or similar forecasting/software tools

Experience managing a small e-commerce or operations team

Familiarity with ClickUp, Asana, or similar project management tools

Mandarin is a plus for supplier communication





What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means keeping operations running smoothly across supply chain and Amazon execution. 

That includes:

> maintaining healthy inventory levels

>reducing stockouts and overstock

>supporting strong FBA inventory performance

>resolving account health and compliance issues quickly improving forecasting accuracy

>helping the team operate with more clarity, accountability, and consistency



(PLEASE TAKE THOUGHTFUL TIME ANSWERING THIS) 

HOW TO APPLY: SEND YOUR UPDATED CV/RESUME WITH THE ANSWER TO THE SCREENING QUESTIONS BELOW:



1) Do you have direct hands-on experience managing Amazon FBA operations in a private label business? Please explain exactly what you personally owned.

3) How many SKUs were under your scope, and what types of products were they?

4) Describe your direct role in forecasting, replenishment, and inventory planning.

5) Have you handled China to USA supply chain, 3PL coordination, or FBA inbound issues? Give one example.

6) Have you personally resolved Amazon account health / policy / IP / compliance issues? Give one real example.

7) Tell us about one operational problem you solved that improved execution, reduced stockouts, or prevented costly errors.

9) Can you work EST hours?

title: B2B Sales / Appointment Setter | Remote | Data-Driven Sellers Only | PHP 96,000 + Incentive | HK Tech Company
description:
About Us

We are a Hong Kong-based technology company specializing in cutting-edge AI engine solutions and AI-powered consumer services. Our clients span across international markets, and we are building a high-performance remote team to accelerate global business growth.

We are not looking for just anyone — we are looking for someone exceptional who thinks in numbers, not just in feelings.



Role: B2B Sales & Business Development Specialist



Location: 100% Remote (Philippines-based)

Salary: PHP 96,000/month (fixed) + performance incentive

Hours: Full-time, Monday–Friday (flexible, aligned to HK/global client time zones)



What You Will Do:

- Conduct outbound prospecting via
, LinkedIn, and video calls to international B2B clients

- Qualify leads and schedule high-value discovery calls / demos for senior stakeholders

- Manage the full sales cycle from first contact through to close

- Maintain accurate pipeline records in CRM (HubSpot or equivalent)

- Track and analyze your own performance data weekly: outreach volume, reply rate, conversion rate, win rate — and adjust your approach based on what the numbers show

Identify funnel bottlenecks using data, form clear hypotheses, and run experiments to improve them

- Research target accounts, market trends, and competitor activity

- Support marketing campaigns and business development initiatives





Our Core Philosophy: Quantitative Before Qualitative

At our company, every business problem is first analyzed with numbers.

? "I feel the campaign isn't working well." — this is NOT analysis.

? "Reply rate dropped from 4.2% to 1.8% week-over-week, likely caused by the subject line change on Tuesday." — this IS analysis.

If you cannot define problems with data, you cannot solve them. We need someone who naturally reaches for numbers when something feels off, and who has actually done this in previous roles — not just heard about it.



Requirements — Must Have

- Graduate of a recognized university (you MUST include your university and degree in your application)

- Business-level English — written and spoken. You will be assessed during the interview

- Proven, hands-on experience analyzing sales or marketing performance using quantitative metrics — you have personally tracked KPIs, diagnosed problems through numbers, and acted on those insights in a real work setting

- Comfort with spreadsheets (Excel / Google Sheets), funnel metrics (conversion rates, drop-off rates), and basic statistical thinking (averages, ratios, trends)

- Proven ability to work independently with minimal supervision

- Strong reporting habits — you proactively flag issues before they become problems

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, international environment





Nice to Have (Strong Advantage)

- Experience in BPO, multinational, or foreign-client-facing roles

- Outbound sales track record (cold
 / LinkedIn outreach / calling) with measurable results you can quote (e.g., "lifted reply rate from 1.5% to 3.8% over 6 weeks")

- CRM experience (HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar) — including building reports or dashboards

- Closing experience with quotable numbers (e.g., "achieved 120% of quota in Q3")

- Exposure to tech, SaaS, or AI-related industries



Please Do NOT Apply If:

- You analyze problems primarily through "feelings" or "general impressions" rather than numbers

- You have never personally tracked your own KPIs or pulled data to diagnose a sales/marketing problem in your previous role

- You expect your manager to identify problems for you — we need someone who finds them first, with data

- You cannot provide proof of your university degree when requested

- Your English communication is primarily written-only with limited spoken fluency

- You require constant supervision to complete tasks

- You are looking for a purely task-execution role with no ownership



If we have to do the analytical thinking for you, hiring you defeats the purpose. Please be honest with yourself before applying.



How to Apply — IMPORTANT: Read carefully. Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed.

To apply, please send your application to 
] with the subject line exactly as written:

"AI Sales – [Your Full Name] – [Your University]"

Your application MUST include all of the following:

1. Your resume / CV (PDF format)

2. A 2–3 minute Loom video introduction (link required — see instructions below)

3. Answers to ALL FOUR screening questions below (in the body of your
)



Loom Video Instructions

Record a short 2–3 minute video at 
 (free) where you:

- Introduce yourself in English (name, university, degree, years of experience)

- Describe one specific situation where you used data or numbers to identify a problem at work — what were the numbers, what did you conclude, and what did you do? (vague answers will be rejected)

- Tell us: What does "working independently" mean to you in practice?



Screening Questions (answer all 4 in your
)

Q1. Which university did you graduate from, and what was your degree?

Q2. Describe a time you had to reach a decision or solve a problem at work without clear instructions from your manager. What did you do, and what was the result?

Q3. Have you used a CRM tool before? If yes, which one, and how did you use it specifically in your sales or BD role? Please include any numbers (e.g., pipeline value managed, conversion rates tracked, deals closed).

Q4. (Quantitative Analysis Case — please answer with numbers)

Imagine you sent 500 cold
s last month and received the following results:



Open rate: 38% (industry average: 40%)

Reply rate: 1.2% (industry average: 3%)

Booked appointments: 2

Closed deals: 0



Based on these numbers alone:

(a) Where is the biggest bottleneck in the funnel, and why? Cite specific numbers in your reasoning.

(b) What two specific experiments would you run next month to improve this, and what result would tell you whether each experiment worked?



Applications missing the Loom video, incorrect subject line, or incomplete answers — especially Q4 with vague non-numerical reasoning — will be automatically filtered out.

We look forward to hearing from candidates who think in data.

You will work in lockstep with our Creative Strategist, taking raw footage (UGC, potentially studio shots) and briefs to produce engaging, platform-optimized video ads primarily for Meta 
/Instagram) and TikTok. Your job is to execute rapidly, iterate effectively based on performance insights (provided by the strategist), and ensure the final output is engineered for maximum engagement and conversions. Forget long-form content; this is about short, punchy, direct-response video.



Key Responsibilities:



• Edit High-Performing Video Ads: Transform raw footage and strategist briefs into compelling video ads optimized for Meta and TikTok feeds/stories/reels.



• Rapid Iteration: Quickly execute multiple variations of winning ad concepts provided by the Creative Strategist (testing different hooks, visuals, text overlays, CTAs, music). Understand that iteration based on data is key.



• Platform Optimization: Expertly edit for platform best practices – strong hooks within the first 3 seconds, fast pacing, engaging captions/text overlays, appropriate aspect ratios (9:16, 1:1, 4:5), safe zones, and effective sound design.



• Integrate Copy & CTAs: Seamlessly weave in primary text concepts, headlines, and clear calls-to-action as guided by the strategist.



• Collaborate Closely: Maintain clear, fast communication (Slack, etc.) with the Creative Strategist to receive feedback, discuss edits, and ensure alignment with performance goals.



• Asset Management: Organize and manage video files and project assets efficiently.



• Meet Deadlines: Deliver high-quality edits reliably and on schedule in a fast-paced environment.



Who We're Looking For:

title: Mid-Level DevOps & Infrastructure Engineer
description:
About the Role 



We are seeking an experienced and highly capable Mid-Level DevOps & Infrastructure Engineer to take full ownership of our DigitalOcean and RunCloud server infrastructure. You will join us at a critical time to immediately lead security remediation and bulk cleanup efforts. Over your first few months, your primary focus will be auditing dozens of servers, identifying and blocking malware entry points, cleaning infected sites, migrating sites to isolated system users, and setting up Cloudflare 



Once the initial security cleanup is complete, your workload will shift heavily from defensive server management to proactive automation, deployment engineering, and scaling our infrastructure standardization efforts. You will work closely with the leadership team, serving as our subject-matter expert to address infrastructure aspects we may not have considered. 

----

Key Responsibilities:



Immediate & Defensive Management (First Few Months):



Immediate Security Action: Execute bulk cleanups and implement all internal security measures. 



Infrastructure Auditing & Remediation: Audit dozens of servers to identify vulnerabilities, clean infected sites, and isolate environments by migrating sites to isolated system users. 



Network Security: We will set up and configure Cloudflare across all domains. 



Cleanup & Stabilization: Clean up the existing infrastructure using a known list of issues and write initial automation scripts to remediate the issues. 

----



Day-to-Day Server & Environment Management:



Morning Check-ins: Review monitoring dashboards daily for offline sites, high CPU loads, or out-of-memory (OOM) errors. 



Security Reviews: Check firewall logs and malware scanner reports regularly for newly blocked threats. 



Routine Patching: Run controlled, automated updates for WordPress core, themes, and plugins across dozens of sites using WP-CLI scripts. 



Client Requests: Provision new servers, migrate new client sites to the infrastructure, and set up SSL certificates. 



Service Optimization: deep dive into the slowest sites to optimize base queries or adjust caching rules. 



Access Control: Set up and manage a secure team access control environment. 



Monitoring: Monitor services running on the cloud and ensure system health. 

-----



Proactive Automation & Long-Term Strategy:



Infrastructure Strategy: D
 how to manage the infrastructure moving forward compared to its current state. Establish a standard setup overall and orchestrate tailored solutions for different clients. 



Long-Term Security: Implement standard, long-term security measures and policies. 



Automation Engineering: Automate server management workflows. Write bash and WP-CLI scripts to update plugins across tons of sites simultaneously and automate the cleanup of bloated databases (revisions, transients). 



Alerting & Uptime: Set up external uptime monitoring (e.g., UptimeRobot) and server metric alerts for CPU/RAM spikes. 



Cloud & Tooling Setup: Assist with cloud-related automation setups and comfortably configure open-source tools (like n8n) directly on servers. 



DevOps Support: Support development teams by applying expertise across development and operations, specifically focusing on scalability, automation, and system security. 



Scaling: Ensure the infrastructure is fully ready to scale to meet our growing requirements. 

----



Expected Experience & Qualifications :



Experience: 4+ years of proven experience in a DevOps, SysAdmin, or Cloud Engineering role. 



Core Linux, IaaS & Cloud Platforms: Solid Linux administration (Ubuntu preferred) and shell scripting (Bash). Strong "IaaS and Linux VPS" experience (AWS or DigitalOcean or similar), alongside hands-on experience with major cloud platforms (AWS, Microsoft Azure, or GCP). You should know how to configure Nginx, manage SSH keys, and troubleshoot CPU spikes. 



Web Servers & Networking: Deep experience with NGINX, SSL certificate management, DNS, load balancing, and general networking/security concepts. 



CI/CD Pipelines: Familiar with building, testing, deploying, and rolling back pipelines using tools like GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab YAML, etc. 



Database Management: Familiarity with database systems such as SQL, MySQL, etc. 



Diagnostics: Excellent diagnostic and troubleshooting skills across infrastructure, applications, and containers. 



Scripting: Highly comfortable writing scripts to automate routine workflows on the server. 



Soft Skills: Good communication and problem-solving skills, with a keen awareness of industry standards and market trends. 



----



Good to Have (Expertise & Skills):



Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field. 



Containerization hands-on experience with Docker, container orchestration, and Kubernetes (managing Docker environments may become part of the role). 



Web Development Concepts: An understanding of basic web development concepts, particularly within WordPress and PHP ecosystems.
